evidence: A Tournament button next to New Game opens a screen with a Players select of 4 and 8 and the matching Player inputs.
Start tournament names an entered player as "Now playing: NAME", and Start turn begins a game on a closed board.
A game ending offers Next turn, and a match ending offers Next match.
Four players play 3 matches to "Champion: NAME", and Back to game returns to the game.
Eight players play 7 matches to "Champion: NAME".
Both players of a match play the same deal, one after the other.
Fewer moves wins the match, whichever player went first.
The bracket shows each player, their moves and the matches at the end.
A finished tournament stays in Past tournaments on the Tournament screen after reload.
Export tournament puts JSON in the box, and Load tournament reads it back after reload, mid-tournament and when finished.
Leave tournament stops it early, before a turn and during one.
The ordinary game still plays after a tournament.
T01: seeds follow entry order. Four meet 1v4 then 2v3, and eight meet 1v8, 4v5, 3v6, then 2v7.
T02: each round shows as "Round: NAME", and a bracket of four has no Quarterfinal.
T03: quarterfinals are played on 4x4, semifinals on 6x6 and finals on 8x8.
T04: both players of a match share one board code, and every match in a tournament has a different one.
T05: equal moves go to the lower active time, and if that is equal too, to the higher seed.
T06: tournament games never change best scores or the saved board size.
N01: names are stored and shown trimmed, with inner whitespace collapsed and normalized to NFC.
N02: a name has 2 to 20 code points after normalization, or "Use 2 to 20 characters." blocks the action.
N03: names compare without case after normalization, or "Each name must be different." blocks the action.
P01: new stored data uses a key of the form np3:THING, with THING a lowercase plural noun.
P02: a stored value is a JSON object with exactly the keys "v", the number 3, and "items", the array of records.
P03: a stored list keeps its newest 10 records and drops older ones when a new record is saved.
P04: with storage blocked the feature works in memory and shows "Progress won't be saved on this device." where its records would appear.
P05: a stored value that fails to parse or validate is treated as empty without any error, and stays untouched until the next save replaces it.
E01: an export has a "format" of neon-pairs/KIND and a whole-number "version", with its keys in alphabetical order at every level.
E02: an import with a field its format does not define shows "Unknown field: NAME." and leaves the current state unchanged.
A01: the bracket is a table with a caption and th scope="col" header cells.
A02: the page has exactly one live region, and "Now playing: NAME" goes through it.
A03: when the feature replaces the main area, focus moves to that screen's h2, which has tabindex="-1".
A04: leaving unfinished work asks in a native dialog with Keep playing, focused first, and Leave, and Escape keeps playing.
A05: every control is at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels at a 390 pixel wide viewport, on every Tournament screen.
V01: under reduced motion nothing on a Tournament screen animates or transitions.
V02: state is never color alone, so a winner is marked with the text "(winner)" after the name. Assertion failed: Match 1 marks its winner.
C01: interface text has no exclamation marks, on any Tournament screen or message.
C02: counts of moves read "2 moves", and durations read M:SS, in the bracket. Assertion failed: "28 moves" shows.
K01: only src/game/session/fresh-board.ts calls a random source.
K02: game code never uses Date, and only src/game/session/ calls performance.now.
K03: the feature lives in src/game/FEATURE/, with its rules in rules.ts, free of React and browser globals.
K04: the feature adds no entries to dependencies or devDependencies.
K05: a feature's rules.ts has a rules.test.ts beside it.
